description: Rank the paid tools in one category by what real buyers spent on them in the last 30 days (x402 and MPP payments, wash trading filtered out). Returns every ranked seller, rank 1 first, each with spend in USD, buyers, paid calls, median price per call, chains, a link to its site and its Agent Charts page. Use it to choose a tool for a job; use seller to check one domain you already know. An unknown slug returns an error: the slugs come from categories. Read-only and free, no sign-in.

category.description: A category slug from categories, such as web-search

max_price.description: Keep only sellers whose median price per call is at most this many USD, such as 0.01. Sellers with no median price stay in

name: best_tools
